# SECURITY.md template for this repo.
# https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/dependabot/working-with-dependabot/guides-for-reporting-vulnerabilities

## Reporting a vulnerability

To report a security vulnerability, please do **not** open a public issue.

Instead, email security@frontal-labs.example with:

- A description of the issue and its impact
- Steps to reproduce
- Affected version(s)
- Any proof of concept

We will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and aim to provide a fix or mitigation within 14 days for critical issues.

## Supported versions

Only the latest minor release line receives security updates.

## Scope

This project runs entirely on your own API key and makes no outbound network calls except to the provider you configured. There is no hosted backend, no telemetry, and no data collection.
